snippet.textDisplay:
Today we had a lecture about procrastination with our English teacher and she decided to show us this beautiful TED talk. I swear to god. I never felt this understood and I probably teared up a bit, but it was beautiful. 
Knowing that someone had the same crazy monkey doing nothing but ruining life as I do made feel way better. I showed this to my mom and i think that was the closest she ever got to understanding me and how i always guilt-trip myself into doing stuff, and that that was why I am as I am. Procrastination ruined my life and I don't think I will ever at on it, but it helps knowing that other people relate and that this vid helps explaining this stuff. I don't like using my procrastination as an excuse, just as a way to say "please be patient, i am trying the best i can and I don't know better"
thank you.

snippet.title: Tim Urban: Inside the mind of a master procrastinator | TED
snippet.description:
Tim Urban knows that procrastination doesn't make sense, but he's never been able to shake his habit of waiting until the last minute to get things done. In this hilarious and insightful talk, Urban takes us on a journey through YouTube binges, Wikipedia rabbit holes and bouts of staring out the window -- and encourages us to think harder about what we're really procrastinating on, before we run out of time.

For more from Tim Urban, visit Wait But Why: http://www.waitbutwhy.com/

Visit http://TED.com to get our entire library of TED Talks, transcripts, translations, personalized talk recommendations and more.
